331: ਕਉਨੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ; ਪਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕੋ ॥
Whose son is anyone? Whose father is anyone?
Who dies? Who inflicts pain on others? ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਠਗ; ਜਗ ਕਉ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
The Lord is the cheat, who has drugged and robbed the whole world.
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਬਿਓਗ; ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਅਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am separated from the Lord; how can I survive, O my mother? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਉਨ ਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਕਉਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Whose husband is anyone? Whose wife is anyone?
Contemplate this reality within your body. ॥2॥
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ; ਠਗ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Says Kabeer, my mind is united with the cheat;
my delusion is gone, and I have recognised the cheat. ॥3॥39॥
ਅਬ ਮੋ ਕਉ; ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Now, the Lord, my King, has become my help and support.
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਟਿ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Cutting away birth and death, I have attained the supreme status. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He has united me with the company of the holy.
He has rescued me from the five demons.
With my tongue, I chant the Ambrosial Name.
He has made me His own slave, without price. ॥1॥
The True Guru has blessed me with His generosity.
He has lifted me up out of the world-ocean.
I have fallen in love with His lotus feet.
The Lord of the universe dwells continually within my consciousness. ॥2॥
The burning fire of Maya has been extinguished.
My mind is content, with the support of the Name.
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
God, the Lord and Master, is pervading the water and the land.
Wherever I look, there is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ॥3॥
He Himself has implanted His devotional worship within me.
By pre-ordained destiny, I have met Him, O my brother.
ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਜ ॥
When He grants His grace, He makes one's life perfect.
Kabeer's Lord and Master is the Cherisher of the poor. ॥4॥40॥
ਜਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ. ਥਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ; ਸੂਤਕ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
There is impurity in the water, and impurity on the land; whatever is born is impure.
ਜਨਮੇ ਸੂਤਕੁ. ਮੂਏ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ; ਸੂਤਕ ਪਰਜ ਬਿਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
There is impurity in birth, and more impurity in death; all beings are ruined by impurity. ॥1॥
Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: who is clean and pure?
ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ; ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Contemplate such spiritual wisdom, O my friend. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ. ਬੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ; ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
There is impurity in the eyes, and impurity in speech; there is impurity in the ears as well.
ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਸੂਤਕੁ ਪਰੈ ਰਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
Standing up and sitting down, one is impure; impurity enters the kitchen. ॥2॥
ਫਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ. ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ; ਛੂਟਨ ਕੀ ਇਕੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Everyone knows how to be caught, but hardly anyone knows how to escape.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ; ਸੂਤਕੁ. ਤਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥੪੧॥
Says Kabeer, those who contemplate the Lord within their hearts are not impure. ॥3॥41॥
Resolve this one dispute for me, O Lord,
ਜਉ ਤੁਮ; ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਸੌ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
if You require any work from Your humble servant. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਡਾ; ਕਿ ਜਾ ਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Is this mind greater, or the One to whom the mind is attuned?
Is the Lord greater, or the one who knows the Lord? ॥1॥
Is Brahma greater, or the One who created him?
ਬੇਦੁ ਬਡਾ; ਕਿ ਜਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Are the Vedas greater, or the One from whom they came? ॥2॥
Says Kabeer, I have become sad;
ਤੀਰਥੁ ਬਡਾ; ਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੩॥੪੨॥
is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage greater, or the slave of the Lord? ॥3॥42॥
ਦੇਖੌ ਭਾਈ; ਗੵਾਨ ਕੀ ਆਈ ਆਂਧੀ ॥
Behold, O brother, the storm of spiritual wisdom has come.
ਸਭੈ ਉਡਾਨੀ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ; ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਾਂਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It has totally blown away the thatched hut of doubt, and torn apart the bonds of Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦੁਚਿਤੇ ਕੀ. ਦੁਇ ਥੂਨਿ ਗਿਰਾਨੀ; ਮੋਹ ਬਲੇਡਾ ਟੂਟਾ ॥
The two pillars of double-mindedness have fallen, and the beams of attachment have come crashing down.
ਤਿਸਨਾ ਛਾਨਿ ਪਰੀ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਫੂਟਾ ॥੧॥
The thatched roof of greed has caved in, and the pitcher of evil-mindedness has been broken. ॥1॥
332: ਆਂਧੀ ਪਾਛੇ. ਜੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਖੈ; ਤਿਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਨਾਂ ॥
Your servant is drenched with the rain that has fallen in this storm.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ; ਉਦੈ ਭਾਨੁ ਜਬ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੪੩॥
Says Kabeer, my mind became illumined, when I saw the sun rise within. ॥2॥43॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
They do not listen to the Lord's praises, and they do not sing the Lord's glories,
but they try to bring down the sky with their talk. ॥1॥
What can anyone say to such people?
ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ. ਕੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਜ; ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਡਰਾਨੇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those whom God has kept away from devotional worship — stay always wary of them. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੇਹਿ; ਚੁਰੂ ਭਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
They themselves would not give even a handful of water,
yet they slander the one who brought forth the Ganges. ॥2॥
Sitting down and standing up, their ways are crooked and wicked.
They ruin themselves, and they ruin others too. ॥3॥
They know nothing but evil talk.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਹੂ ਕੋ; ਕਹਿਓ. ਨ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥੪॥
They would not even obey Brahma's orders. ॥4॥
They themselves are lost, and they mislead others as well.
They set fire to their own house, and then they fall asleep in it. ॥5॥
They laugh at others, while they themselves are one-eyed.
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜੀਵਤ ਪਿਤਰ. ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ; ਮੂਏਂ. ਸਿਰਾਧ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
People do not honour their ancestors while they are alive, but they hold feasts in their honour after they have died.
ਪਿਤਰ ਭੀ ਬਪੁਰੇ. ਕਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਕਊਆ ਕੂਕਰ ਖਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Tell me, how can the poor ancestors receive what the crows and dogs have eaten up? ॥1॥
If only someone would tell me what real happiness is!
ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕਰਤੇ. ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Speaking of happiness and joy, the world is perishing. How can happiness be found? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
Making gods and goddesses out of clay, people sacrifice living beings to them.
ਐਸੇ ਪਿਤਰ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ; ਆਪਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
Such are your dead ancestors, who cannot ask for what they want. ॥2॥
ਸਰਜੀਉ ਕਾਟਹਿ, ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ; ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਕਉ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
You murder living beings and worship lifeless things; at your very last moment, you shall suffer terribly.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ; ਭੈ ਡੂਬੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
You do not know the value of the Lord's Name; you shall drown in the terrifying world-ocean. ॥3॥
ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਡੋਲਹਿ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
You worship gods and goddesses and remain in fear; you do not know the Supreme Lord God.
ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ. ਅਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੫॥
Says Kabeer, you have not remembered the Lord who has no ancestry; you are clinging to your corrupt ways. ॥4॥1॥45॥
ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ. ਮਰੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵੈ; ਐਸੇ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
One who remains dead while yet alive, and having died lives again, merges thus in the state where no thought arises.
ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Remaining pure in the midst of Maya, such a one shall never again fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ॥1॥
O my Lord, this is the milk to be churned.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਓਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru's teachings, hold your mind steady and stable, and in this way, drink in the nectar. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਾਣਿ. ਬਜਰ ਕਲ ਛੇਦੀ; ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਪਦੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
The Guru's arrow has pierced the hard core of this Dark Age, and the state of enlightenment has dawned.
ਸਕਤਿ ਅਧੇਰ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
In the darkness of Maya, I mistook the rope for the snake, but that is over, and now I dwell in the eternal home of the Lord. ॥2॥
ਤਿਨਿ. ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੈ ਧਨਖੁ ਚਢਾਈਐ; ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥
He has drawn the bow without the arrow, and pierced this world, O brother.
333: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬੂਡੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਵੈ; ਡੋਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
Buffeted about in the ten directions, the kite is blown by the wind, but its string remains attuned to the Lord. ॥3॥
ਉਨਮਨਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
The restless mind has merged into the state of detachment, and duality and evil-mindedness have run away.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਅਨਭਉ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੬॥
Says Kabeer, I have seen the One, the fearless Lord; I am attuned to the Lord's Name. ॥4॥2॥46॥
ਉਲਟਤ ਪਵਨ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਖਟੁ ਭੇਦੇ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥
Turning back the wandering mind, I have pierced the six chakras, and my consciousness is attuned to the state free of thought.
ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ. ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ; ਤਾਸੁ ਖੋਜੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
Seek Him, O detached one, who neither comes nor goes, neither dies nor is born. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਮਨ ਹੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
My mind, turning away from the world, has merged into the Mind of God.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ. ਅਕਲਿ ਭਈ ਅਵਰੈ; ਨਾਤਰੁ. ਥਾ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace, my understanding has been changed; otherwise, I was a stranger to Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਿਵਰੈ ਦੂਰਿ. ਦੂਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਿਵਰੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
That which was near has become distant, and the distant has become near, for one who realises the Lord as He is.
ਅਲਉਤੀ ਕਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਇਆ ਬਰੇਡਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
It is like the sugar-water made from candy; only one who drinks it knows its taste. ॥2॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਥਾ. ਕਾਇ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ; ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ॥
Unto whom should I speak Your sermon, O Lord, beyond the three qualities? Is there anyone so discerning?
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਪਲੀਤਾ; ਤਿਨਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਝਲ ਦੇਖੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੪੭॥
Says Kabeer, as is the fuse which one applies, such is the flash one sees. ॥3॥3॥47॥
ਤਹ ਪਾਵਸ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਧੂਪ ਨਹੀ ਛਹੀਆ; ਤਹ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
There is no rainy season, ocean, sunshine or shade there, and no creation or destruction.
ਜੀਵਨ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਦੋਊ. ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
No life or death is felt there, no pain or pleasure; there is only the primal trance of the Void, where there is no duality. ॥1॥
ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ; ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥
The description of the state of intuitive poise is indescribable and unique.
ਤੁਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਚਢੈ, ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮੁਕਾਤੀ; ਹਲੁਕੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It is not measured, and it is not exhausted; it is neither light nor heavy. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਦੋਊ. ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ; ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Neither lower nor higher worlds are there; neither day nor night is there.
ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨੁ. ਪਾਵਕੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਹਾ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
There is no water, wind or fire; the True Guru is contained there. ॥2॥
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
The inaccessible and unfathomable Lord dwells there within Himself; by the Guru's grace, He is found.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥੪॥੪੮॥
Says Kabeer, I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I remain in the true congregation. ॥3॥4॥48॥
ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਬੈਲ ਬਿਸਾਹੇ; ਪਵਨੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਓ ॥
Mortals have purchased two bullocks, sin and virtue, and set out with the capital of the breath of life.
ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗੂਣਿ ਭਰੀ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਟਾਂਡ ਬਿਸਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
The sack on their back is filled with desire; in this way, they have loaded their merchandise. ॥1॥
Such is my Lord, the Wealthy Merchant!
He has made the whole world His peddler. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਏ ਜਗਾਤੀ; ਮਨ ਤਰੰਗ ਬਟਵਾਰਾ ॥
Sexual desire and anger are the tax collectors, and the waves of the mind are the highway robbers.
ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ. ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਹਿ; ਟਾਂਡਾ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Together with the five elements, they settle the account by taking everything, and so the merchandise passes over to the other side. ॥2॥
ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ. ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਅਬ ਐਸੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Says Kabeer, listen, O saints: now this is the situation!
ਘਾਟੀ ਚਢਤ ਬੈਲੁ ਇਕੁ ਥਾਕਾ; ਚਲੋ ਗੋਨਿ ਛਿਟਕਾਈ ॥੩॥੫॥੪੯॥
Going uphill, one bullock has become tired; he has thrown off his load, and run away. ॥3॥5॥49॥
ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ; ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
For a few short days, the soul-bride stays in her parents' home; then she must go to her in-laws.
ਅੰਧਾ ਲੋਕੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਈ; ਮੂਰਖੁ ਏਆਣਾ ॥੧॥
The blind, foolish and ignorant people do not know this. ॥1॥
Tell me, why is the bride standing there in her ordinary clothes?
ਪਾਹੂ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ; ਮੁਕਲਾਊ ਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The guests have come to her home, and her husband has come to take her away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਓਹ ਜਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਖੂਹੜੀ; ਕਉਨ ਲਾਜੁ ਵਹਾਰੀ ॥
Who has lowered the rope into the well which we see?
ਲਾਜੁ ਘੜੀ ਸਿਉ ਤੂਟਿ ਪੜੀ; ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
The rope breaks along with the pitcher, and the water-carrier gets up and leaves. ॥2॥
ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ, ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
When the Lord and Master is merciful and shows His grace, He resolves her affairs.
334: Then she is known as the happy soul-bride, as she contemplates the Word of the Guru. ॥3॥
ਕਿਰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ. ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ; ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Reflect and see: everyone wanders about, bound by their past actions.
ਏਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਆ ਆਖੀਐ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
What can we say to her? What can the poor bride do? ॥4॥
ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ; ਚਿਤ ਬੰਧਿ. ਨ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
Without hope, she arises and departs; her mind does not find steadiness or patience.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ; ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥੫੦॥
Remain attached to the Lord's feet, and seek His sanctuary, O Kabeer. ॥5॥6॥50॥
ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਹਿ. ਜੋਗੁ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
The Yogi says that Yoga is good and sweet, and nothing else is, O brother.
ਰੁੰਡਿਤ ਮੁੰਡਿਤ ਏਕੈ ਸਬਦੀ; ਏਇ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Those with shaven heads, and those who have only one name — they all claim to have attained spiritual perfection. ॥1॥
Without the Lord, the blind are deluded by doubt.
ਜਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਉ, ਆਪੁ ਛੁਟਕਾਵਨਿ; ਤੇ. ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those I approach for release from ego are themselves tied by many bonds. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ. ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੀ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
The ego merges back into that from which it originated; this way of understanding is forgotten.
ਪੰਡਿਤ ਗੁਣੀ ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ; ਏਹਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਬਡ ਹਮ ਹੀ ॥੨॥
The pandits, the virtuous, the heroes and the generous all say that they alone are great. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ. ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ. ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand; without understanding, how can one live?
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚੂਕੈ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
Meeting the True Guru, darkness is dispelled, and in this way the jewel is obtained. ॥3॥
ਤਜਿ ਬਾਵੇ ਦਾਹਨੇ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Give up the evil thoughts that stray to the left and right, and hold fast to the Lord's feet.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੂੰਗੈ ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਇਆ; ਪੂਛੇ ਤੇ. ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੧॥
Says Kabeer, the mute has eaten the molasses; if he is asked about it, what can he say? ॥4॥7॥51॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਹ ਕਛੁ ਅਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Where there was something, now there is nothing; the five elements are no longer there.
ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਬੰਦੇ; ਏ ਅਵਗਨ, ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
The Ida, the Pingala and the Sushmanaa — how can these faults be counted now? ॥1॥
ਤਾਗਾ ਤੂਟਾ. ਗਗਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ; ਤੇਰਾ ਬੋਲਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
The thread is broken, and the tenth gate is destroyed; where has your speech gone?
ਏਹ ਸੰਸਾ. ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This wonder afflicts me night and day; no one can explain it to me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਹ ਬਰਭੰਡੁ. ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ; ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Where the world was, there the body is not; the maker of illusions is not there either.
ਜੋੜਨਹਾਰੋ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤਾ; ਇਹ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
The Joiner is ever detached; to whom can this be told? ॥2॥
ਜੋੜੀ ਜੁੜੈ ਨ ਤੋੜੀ ਤੂਟੈ; ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
By joining, one cannot be joined, and by breaking, one cannot be broken, so long as one is identified with the perishable.
ਕਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ. ਕਾ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
Who is the master, and who is the servant? Who can go to whom? ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ; ਜਹਾ ਬਸੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Says Kabeer, my consciousness is attuned to the place where the Lord dwells, day and night.
ਉਆ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ. ਓਹੀ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਓਹੁ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੨॥
Only He Himself truly knows His secret; He is eternal and imperishable. ॥4॥1॥52॥
ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਦੁਇ, ਕੰਨੀ ਮੁੰਦਾ; ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
Let meditation and remembrance be the two ear-rings, and true knowledge of God the patched coat.
ਸੁੰਨ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਬੈਸਣੁ; ਕਲਪ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ. ਪੰਥਾ ॥੧॥
I sit in the cave of silence, in a posture free of thought; renouncing desires is my path. ॥1॥
O my King, I am a Yogi, detached from the world.
I do not suffer death, sorrow or separation. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਟੂਆ; ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਸਮਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
The solar systems and galaxies are my horn; the whole world is my bag for carrying ashes.
ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਲੁ ਪਲਟੀਐ; ਛੂਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Setting aside the three qualities, I am in deep trance; thus, though a householder, I am freed. ॥2॥
ਮਨੁ ਪਵਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਤੂੰਬਾ ਕਰੀ ਹੈ; ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗ ਸਾਰਦ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
My mind and breath are the two gourds of the fiddle, and the Lord of all ages is its frame.
335: ਥਿਰੁ ਭਈ ਤੰਤੀ. ਤੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਅਨਹਦ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੀ ॥੩॥
The string has become steady, and does not break; this fiddle vibrates with the unstruck melody. ॥3॥
ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ. ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ; ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲ. ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Hearing it, the mind becomes enraptured and perfect; it does not waver, and it is not affected by Maya.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਤਾ ਕਉ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹੀ; ਖੇਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੩॥
Says Kabeer, the detached hermit who has played such a game is not reincarnated again. ॥4॥2॥53॥
ਗਜ ਨਵ. ਗਜ ਦਸ. ਗਜ ਇਕੀਸ; ਪੁਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਤਨਾਈ ॥
Nine yards, ten yards and twenty-one yards — weave these into the full piece of cloth;
ਸਾਠ ਸੂਤ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਬਹਤਰਿ; ਪਾਟੁ ਲਗੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
take the sixty threads, and add nine joints to the seventy-two. ॥1॥
Desire goes out to have the cloth of the body woven,
when the weaver leaves the home of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗਜੀ. ਨ ਮਿਨੀਐ; ਤੋਲਿ. ਨ ਤੁਲੀਐ; ਪਾਚਨੁ ਸੇਰ ਅਢਾਈ ॥
This cloth cannot be measured in yards, or weighed with weights; its food is two and a half measures a day.
ਜੌ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਚਨੁ. ਬੇਗਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਝਗਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਘਰਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
If it does not receive its food promptly, it raises a quarrel in the home. ॥2॥
ਦਿਨ ਕੀ ਬੈਠ. ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਸ; ਇਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਤ ਆਈ ॥
For the sake of these few days, one turns against the Lord and Master; how will this opportunity come again?
ਛੂਟੇ ਕੂੰਡੇ. ਭੀਗੈ ਪੁਰੀਆ; ਚਲਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ਰੀਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
Leaving behind the pots and pans, and the wet bobbins, the weaver departs in anger. ॥3॥
ਛੋਛੀ ਨਲੀ. ਤੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ; ਨਤਰ ਰਹੀ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥
The shuttle is now empty; the thread no longer comes out, and the tangle no longer holds.
ਛੋਡਿ ਪਸਾਰੁ. ਈਹਾ ਰਹੁ ਬਪੁਰੀ; ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੪॥
So renounce worldly entanglements, O wretched desire, and leave this soul be; says Kabeer, understand this! ॥4॥3॥54॥
ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ. ਏਕਾ ਮਿਲੀ; ਕਿੰਬਾ ਹੋਇ, ਮਹੋਇ ॥
When one's light merges with the Light, there is no ego left at all.
ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਊਪਜੈ; ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
That person, within whose heart the Name does not well up, shall burst and die. ॥1॥
O my dark and beautiful Lord,
my mind is attached to You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਿ ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਿ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
Meeting the holy Guru, perfection is obtained; what then is Yoga, and what is indulgence?
ਦੁਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
When the two meet, the work is accomplished, and one is joined with the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
ਲੋਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਗੀਤੁ ਹੈ; ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
People believe that this is just a song, but it is a meditation on God.
ਜਿਉ ਕਾਸੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹੋਇ; ਮਾਨਸ ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
It is like the instruction given to the dying man at Benares. ॥3॥
ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ. ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Whoever sings or listens to the Lord's Name with focused consciousness —
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਸਾ ਨਹੀ; ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥੫੫॥
says Kabeer, without a doubt, in the end, they obtain the highest status. ॥4॥1॥4॥55॥
ਜੇਤੇ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ. ਤੇ ਡੂਬੇ; ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
Those who make their own efforts are drowned in the terrifying world-ocean; they cannot cross over.
ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਜਮ; ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Those who practise religious rituals and strict self-discipline — their pride of intellect consumes their minds. ॥1॥
ਸਾਸ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਕੋ ਦਾਤੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
Your Lord and Master gave you the breath of life and food to sustain you; why have you forgotten Him?
ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ; ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Human birth is a priceless jewel, a ruby, and you have squandered it in exchange for a shell. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਭੂਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਲਾਗੀ; ਹਿਰਦੈ. ਨਾਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
The thirst of desire and the hunger of doubt afflict you; you do not contemplate the Lord in your heart.
ਉਨਮਤ ਮਾਨ ਹਿਰਿਓ, ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Intoxicated with pride, you deceive yourself; you have not enshrined the Word of the Guru within your mind. ॥2॥
ਸੁਆਦ ਲੁਭਤ. ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ; ਮਦ ਰਸ ਲੈਤ ਬਿਕਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
Lured by the tastes of sensual pleasures, driven by the cravings of the senses, you savour the intoxicating wine of vice.
ਕਰਮ ਭਾਗ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਾਨੇ; ਕਾਸਟ. ਲੋਹ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
By good destiny and karma, one joins the company of the saints; like iron attached to wood, one is carried across. ॥3॥
ਧਾਵਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਾਕੇ; ਅਬ ਦੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
I have wandered through countless lifetimes and wombs, and I am so tired; now I have grown weary of pain and given up.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥੫੬॥
Says Kabeer, meeting the Guru, I have obtained the supreme essence; my loving devotion has saved me. ॥4॥1॥5॥56॥
ਕਾਲਬੂਤ ਕੀ ਹਸਤਨੀ, ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਚਲਤੁ ਰਚਿਓ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
Like the straw elephant made to trap a real one, O crazy mind, the Lord of the universe has staged this play of the world.
ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਇ. ਗਜ ਬਸਿ ਪਰੇ, ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਹਿਓ ਸੀਸ ॥੧॥
Attracted by sexual desire, the elephant is captured, O crazy mind, and now the halter is put on its head. ॥1॥
336: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਚੁ. ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੁ; ਸਮਝੁ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ॥
Escape corruption and immerse yourself in the Lord; take this advice, O crazy mind.
ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ. ਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ; ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ, ਗਹਿਓ ਨ. ਰਾਮ ਜਹਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You did not meditate on the Lord fearlessly, O crazy mind; you did not board the boat of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਰਕਟ ਮੁਸਟੀ ਅਨਾਜ ਕੀ. ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਲੀਨੀ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
The monkey stretches out its hand, O crazy mind, and takes a handful of grain.
ਛੂਟਨ ਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਪਰਿਆ. ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਨਾਚਿਓ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Now, trying to escape, O crazy mind, it is made to dance at every door. ॥2॥
ਜਿਉ ਨਲਨੀ. ਸੂਅਟਾ ਗਹਿਓ, ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਮਾਯਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
Like the parrot caught in the trap, O crazy mind, you are caught by the affairs of Maya.
ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ, ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਤਿਉ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Like the faint colour of the safflower, O crazy mind, so is the expanse of the world. ॥3॥
ਨਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਘਨੇ, ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਪੂਜਨ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵ ॥
There are so many sacred shrines in which to bathe, O crazy mind, and so many gods to worship.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਹੀ, ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਛੂਟਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੫੭॥
Says Kabeer, you shall not be saved like this, O crazy mind; only by serving the Lord shall you be saved. ॥4॥1॥6॥57॥
ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਦਹੈ, ਪਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਗਨੈ; ਤਸਕਰੁ. ਨੇਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Fire does not burn it, and the wind does not blow it away; thieves cannot approach it.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ, ਕਰਿ ਸੰਚਉਨੀ; ਸੋ ਧਨੁ. ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Gather the wealth of the Lord's Name; that wealth does not go anywhere. ॥1॥
ਹਮਰਾ ਧਨੁ. ਮਾਧਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ; ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
My wealth is the Lord, the Master of Maya, the Lord of the universe, the Support of the earth; this is said to be the most excellent wealth.
ਜੋ ਸੁਖੁ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ. ਰਾਜਿ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The peace obtained by serving God, the Lord of the universe — that peace is not found in kingdoms or power. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ. ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ; ਖੋਜਤ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
Shiva and Sanak, searching for this wealth, became renunciates.
ਮਨਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ. ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ; ਪਰੈ ਨ. ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
Those whose minds are filled with the Liberator, and whose tongues chant the Lord's Name — they are not caught by the noose of death. ॥2॥
ਨਿਜ ਧਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ, ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ; ਤਾਸੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
My own wealth is the spiritual wisdom and devotion given by the Guru; my mind is attached to that sublime understanding.
ਜਲਤ ਅੰਭ, ਥੰਭਿ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤ; ਭਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
It is like water to the burning soul, and a pillar to the wandering mind; the fear of the bonds of doubt has run away. ॥3॥
ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ. ਮਦਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Says Kabeer, O you who are intoxicated with sexual desire, reflect and see within your heart:
ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਹਸਤੀ; ਹਮ ਘਰਿ. ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੫੮॥
in your home are hundreds of thousands, even millions, of horses and elephants; but in my home is the One Lord. ॥4॥1॥7॥58॥
ਜਿਉ ਕਪਿ ਕੇ ਕਰ. ਮੁਸਟਿ ਚਨਨ ਕੀ; ਲੁਬਧਿ. ਨ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
Like the monkey with a handful of corn, which will not let go of it because of greed,
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ. ਲਾਲਚ ਸਿਉ; ਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ. ਗਰਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
all the deeds committed in greed ultimately become a noose around one's neck. ॥1॥
Without devotional worship, human life passes away in vain.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the company of the holy, without meditating on the Lord God, the True One does not abide anywhere. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ. ਕੁਸਮ ਪਰਫੁਲਿਤ; ਕਿਨਹਿ. ਨ ਘ੍ਰਾਉ ਲਇਓ ॥
Like the flower which blossoms in the wilderness with no one to enjoy its fragrance,
ਤੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲ ਹਇਓ ॥੨॥
so do people wander in reincarnation, and are struck down by death again and again. ॥2॥
ਇਆ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ; ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਜੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
This wealth, youth, children and spouse which the Lord has given you — this is all just a passing show.
ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਟਕਿ. ਜੋ ਉਰਝੇ; ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿ ਲਇਓ ॥੩॥
Those who are caught up and entangled in these are carried away by the cravings of the senses. ॥3॥
ਅਉਧ ਅਨਲ. ਤਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ; ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਠਾਟੁ ਠਇਓ ॥
Age is the fire, and the body is the house of straw; on all four sides, this play is being played out.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰਨ ਕਉ; ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਲਇਓ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥੫੯॥
Says Kabeer, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean, I have taken the shelter of the True Guru. ॥4॥1॥8॥59॥
The father's seed is impure, and the mother's blood is red.
From this clay, the puppet of the body has been fashioned. ॥1॥
ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕਛੁ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
I am nothing, and nothing is mine.
ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਸੁ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This body, wealth and all delights are Yours, O Lord of the universe. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Into this clay, the breath has been infused.
337: By false means, one sets up a sham show and drives it on. ॥2॥
Some have amassed five hundred thousand,
but at the very last moment, the pitcher bursts. ॥3॥
Says Kabeer, the one foundation that you have laid
will be destroyed in an instant, O egotist. ॥4॥1॥9॥60॥
O my soul, meditate on the Lord in such a way,
just as Dhroo and Prahlaad meditated on the Lord. ॥1॥
O Lord, merciful to the meek, I have placed my faith in You;
with all my family, I have come aboard Your boat. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ॥
When it pleases Him, He inspires us to obey His command,
and He causes this boat to cross over. ॥2॥
By the Guru's grace, such understanding is infused into me;
my comings and goings in reincarnation have ended. ॥3॥
Says Kabeer, meditate on the Lord who holds the bow;
in this world and the next, He alone is the Giver. ॥4॥2॥10॥61॥
ਜੋਨਿ ਛਾਡਿ; ਜਉ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
When one leaves the womb and comes into the world,
as soon as the air touches one, the Lord and Master is forgotten. ॥1॥
ਜੀਅਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨਾ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O my soul, sing the glorious praises of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ; ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Upside down in the womb, you practised intense meditation,
and so you survived the fire of the belly. ॥2॥
After wandering through 8.4 million forms of life, you have come.
ਅਬ ਕੇ ਛੁਟਕੇ; ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
If you stumble and fall now, you shall find no home or place of rest. ॥3॥
Says Kabeer, meditate on the Lord who holds the bow,
who is not seen to come or go. ॥4॥1॥11॥62॥
ਸੁਰਗ ਬਾਸੁ. ਨ ਬਾਛੀਐ; ਡਰੀਐ ਨ. ਨਰਕਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Do not long for a home in heaven, and do not be afraid of living in hell.
ਹੋਨਾ ਹੈ. ਸੋ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; ਮਨਹਿ. ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
Whatever will be will be, so do not get your hopes up in your mind. ॥1॥
Sing the glorious praises of the Lord,
ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ; ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
from whom the most excellent treasure is obtained. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ; ਕਿਆ ਬਰਤੁ ਕਿਆ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
What good is chanting, penance or self-discipline? What good is fasting or ritual bathing,
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ. ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ; ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥
until you know the way of loving devotion to the Lord God? ॥2॥
ਸੰਪੈ ਦੇਖਿ. ਨ ਹਰਖੀਐ; ਬਿਪਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ. ਨ ਰੋਇ ॥
Do not be so delighted at the sight of wealth, and do not weep at the sight of suffering.
ਜਿਉ ਸੰਪੈ. ਤਿਉ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਹੈ; ਬਿਧ ਨੇ ਰਚਿਆ. ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
As is wealth, so is adversity; whatever the Lord proposes comes to pass. ॥3॥
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਸੰਤਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
Says Kabeer, now I know that the Lord dwells within the hearts of His saints.
ਸੇਵਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਲੇ; ਜਿਹ ਘਟ ਬਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥੬੩॥
That servant performs the best service, whose heart is filled with the Lord. ॥4॥1॥12॥63॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ. ਤੇਰੋ ਕੋਇ ਨਹੀ; ਖਿੰਚਿ ਲੇਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
O my mind, no one is yours; do not take the burden of others on your head.
ਬਿਰਖ ਬਸੇਰੋ ਪੰਖਿ ਕੋ; ਤੈਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Like the bird roosting in the tree, so is this world. ॥1॥
I drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.
ਜਿਹ ਰਸ; ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਰਸ ਅਉਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
With the taste of this essence, I have forgotten all other tastes. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਉਰ ਮੁਏ. ਕਿਆ ਰੋਈਐ; ਜਉ ਆਪਾ. ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਇ ॥
Why should we weep at the death of others, when we ourselves are not permanent?
ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ. ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਹੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Whoever is born shall pass away; why should we cry out in grief? ॥2॥
ਜਹ ਕੀ ਉਪਜੀ. ਤਹ ਰਚੀ; ਪੀਵਤ. ਮਰਦਨ ਲਾਗ ॥
The soul is reabsorbed into the One from whom it came, drinking in the essence and attached to it.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਚਿਤਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ; ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੩॥੬੪॥
Says Kabeer, my consciousness is filled with thoughts of remembrance of the Lord; I have become detached from the world. ॥3॥2॥13॥64॥
ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਮਨੀ; ਲੋਚਨ ਭਰੀ. ਲੇ ਉਸਾਸਾ ॥
The bride gazes at the path, and sighs with tear-filled eyes.
338: ਉਰ. ਨ ਭੀਜੈ, ਪਗੁ. ਨਾ ਖਿਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥੧॥
Her heart is not satisfied, and her feet do not move, in the hope of seeing her Lord. ॥1॥
ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ; ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so that I may meet my Beloved Lord soon. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Says Kabeer, to obtain the status of true life, worship the Lord with devotion.
ਏਕੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ; ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥੬੫॥
The Name of the Lord is my only support; with my tongue, I chant the Lord's Name. ॥2॥1॥14॥65॥
ਆਸ ਪਾਸ ਘਨ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਵਾ; ਮਾਝ ਬਨਾ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਊਂ ਰੇ ॥
Around Him grow the dense basil bushes, and in the midst of the forest He sang with joy.
ਉਆ ਕਾ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਆਰਨਿ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Beholding His wondrous beauty, the milkmaid was enticed, and pleaded: "Please do not leave me; please do not come and go!" ॥1॥
My mind is attached to Your feet, O Lord who holds the bow;
he alone meets You, who is blessed with great good fortune. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ. ਮਨ ਹਰਨ ਮਨੋਹਰ; ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਊ ਰੇ ॥
In Brindaaban, where Krishna grazed his cows, he enticed and fascinated my mind.
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ; ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਨਾਊ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥੬੬॥
You are my Lord and Master, O Lord who holds the bow; my name is Kabeer. ॥2॥2॥15॥66॥
ਬਿਪਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਪਹਿਰੇ; ਕਿਆ ਬਨ ਮਧੇ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
Many wear various robes, but what good is it to live in the forest?
ਕਹਾ ਭਇਆ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ਧੋਖੇ; ਕਿਆ ਜਲਿ ਬੋਰਿਓ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧॥
What good is it, O man, if you burn incense before your gods? What good is it to dip your body in water? ॥1॥
O soul, I know that you shall have to depart.
O ignorant fool, understand the Imperishable Lord.
ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ. ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਉ; ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever you see, you shall not see again, and yet you cling to Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ; ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਗਲੋ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
The spiritual teachers, meditators and great preachers are all engrossed in these worldly affairs.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੬॥੬੭॥
Says Kabeer, without the One Name of the Lord, this world is blinded by Maya. ॥2॥1॥16॥67॥
ਮਨ ਰੇ. ਛਾਡਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ; ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਚਹੁ. ਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਡਾਂਡੇ ॥
O mind, give up your doubts, and dance openly; these are merely the deceptions of Maya.
ਸੂਰੁ ਕਿ. ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪੈ; ਸਤੀ ਕਿ. ਸਾਂਚੈ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥੧॥
What sort of hero is afraid to face battle? What sort of true wife, when the time comes, starts tending her household pots? ॥1॥
Stop your wavering, O crazy mind!
ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਰੇ ਮਰੇ. ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਲੀਨੋ ਹਾਥਿ ਸੰਧਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Now that you have taken the sindoor-smeared coconut in your hand, only by burning and dying shall you attain perfection. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ; ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
The world is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya; in this way, it is plundered and destroyed.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ; ਸਗਲ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੭॥੬੮॥
Says Kabeer, do not abandon the Lord, the Sovereign King, the highest of the high. ॥2॥2॥17॥68॥
ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਿਰੈ ਊਪਰਿ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਨ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Your command is upon my head, and I no longer question it.
ਤੁਹੀ ਦਰੀਆ. ਤੁਹੀ ਕਰੀਆ; ਤੁਝੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
You are the river, and You are the boatman; salvation comes from You. ॥1॥
O human being, embrace the Lord's meditation,
ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਰੋਸੁ ਧਰਉ ਕਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whether your Lord and Master is angry with you or in love with you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਜਿਉ ਫੂਲੁ ਜਈ ਹੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Your Name is my support, like the flower blossoming in the water.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੁਲਾਮੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ; ਜੀਆਇ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੬੯॥
Says Kabeer, I am the slave of Your household; You may let me live or kill me. ॥2॥18॥69॥
ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ; ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨੰਦੁ ਬਹੁ ਥਾਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
Wandering through 8.4 million lives, Krishna's father Nand was utterly exhausted.
ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਲੀਓ ਹੈ; ਭਾਗੁ ਬਡੋ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Because of his devotion, Krishna was incarnated in his house — how great was the good fortune of this poor man! ॥1॥
ਤੁਮੑ ਜੁ ਕਹਤ ਹਉ ਨੰਦ ਕੋ ਨੰਦਨੁ; ਨੰਦ ਸੁ ਨੰਦਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
You say that Krishna was the son of Nand; then whose son was Nand himself?
ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸ ਨਾਹੀ; ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਨੰਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਥੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When there was no earth, no sky and no ten directions, where was this Nand then? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
339: ਸੰਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਰੈ. ਜੋਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
He does not fall into trouble, and He does not come into the womb; His Name is the Immaculate Lord.
ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ. ਐਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਜਾ ਕੈ. ਮਾਈ ਨ ਬਾਪੋ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੭੦॥
Kabeer's Lord is such a Lord and Master, who has no mother or father. ॥2॥19॥70॥
ਨਿੰਦਉ; ਨਿੰਦਉ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਲੋਗੁ ਨਿੰਦਉ ॥
Slander me, slander me — go ahead, people, and slander me.
Slander is very pleasing to the Lord's humble servant.
Slander is my father, slander is my mother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
If I am slandered, I go to heaven,
and the wealth of the Name abides within my mind.
If my heart is pure and I am slandered,
then the slanderer washes my clothes. ॥1॥
One who slanders me is my friend;
my attention is on the slanderer.
The true slanderer is the one who prevents me from being slandered.
The slanderer wishes me a good life. ॥2॥
Slander of me awakens love and affection within me;
slander of me is my salvation.
For servant Kabeer, slander is the best thing.
The slanderer is drowned, while I am carried across. ॥3॥20॥71॥
ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ. ਤੂੰ ਐਸਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ; ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ, ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O my Sovereign Lord, You are fearless; You are the boat to carry us across, O my Lord King. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹੋਤੇ, ਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਨਾਹੀ; ਅਬ ਤੁਮ ਹਹੁ, ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
When I was, then You were not; now that You are, I am not.
ਅਬ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ, ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹਹਿ; ਏਕੈ ਦੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਹੀ ॥੧॥
Now You and I have become one; seeing this, my mind is content. ॥1॥
ਜਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਤੀ. ਤਬ ਬਲੁ ਕੈਸਾ; ਅਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲੁ ਨ ਖਟਾਈ ॥
When there was worldly wisdom, how could there be strength? Now that there is wisdom, worldly strength cannot prevail.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਬੁਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਈ ਮੇਰੀ; ਬੁਧਿ ਬਦਲੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
Says Kabeer, the Lord has taken away my wisdom, and I have attained spiritual perfection. ॥2॥21॥72॥
ਖਟ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ; ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਬੀਚ ਪਾਈ ॥
He created the tiny body-chamber of the six chakras, and placed the incomparable thing within it.
ਕੁੰਜੀ ਕੁਲਫੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਕਰਤੇ. ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
He made the breath of life the watchman, with lock and key; the Creator did not take any time to do this. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਮਨ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੁ; ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Keep your mind awake and aware now, O brother.
ਗਾਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ. ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ; ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You were careless, and you have wasted your life; your house is being plundered by thieves. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪੰਚ ਪਹਰੂਆ. ਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
The five senses stand as guards at the gate, but they cannot be trusted.
ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਚੇਤ. ਚਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ; ਤਉ ਲੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਉਜਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
When you are conscious in your consciousness, you shall be enlightened and illumined. ॥2॥
ਨਉ ਘਰ ਦੇਖਿ. ਜੁ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਭੂਲੀ; ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Seeing the nine openings of the body, the soul-bride goes astray; she does not obtain this incomparable thing.
ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਨਵੈ ਘਰ ਮੂਸੇ; ਦਸਵੈਂ ਤਤੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥੨੨॥੭੩॥
Says Kabeer, when the nine openings are subdued, one merges into the essence of the tenth gate. ॥3॥22॥73॥
ਮਾਈ. ਮੋਹਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਓ; ਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
O mother, I do not know any other than the Lord.
ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ. ਜਾਸੁ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਤਾਸੁ ਬਸਹਿ ਮੋਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My breath of life abides in Him, whose glorious praises Shiva and Sanak sing. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਿਰਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੰਮਿਤ; ਗਗਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
My heart is illumined by the spiritual wisdom attained from the Guru, and my meditation is fixed in the highest realm.
ਬਿਖੈ ਰੋਗ ਭੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਾਗੇ; ਮਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
The diseases of corruption, fear and bondage have run away; my mind has come to know peace in its own true home. ॥1॥
ਏਕ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਰਤਿ. ਜਾਨਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਦੂਸਰ ਮਨਹਿ. ਨ ਆਨਾਨਾ ॥
Imbued with single-minded understanding, I know and believe in God alone; nothing else enters my mind.
ਚੰਦਨ ਬਾਸੁ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਬਾਸਨ; ਤਿਆਗਿ ਘਟਿਓ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
My mind is fragrant as sandalwood, having renounced its desires; my egotistical pride has dwindled. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਜਨ ਗਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਤਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੈ ਥਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
That humble being who sings and meditates on the praises of the Lord and Master is the dwelling place of God.
ਤਿਹ ਬਡ ਭਾਗ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਮਥਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Great is the fortune of the one within whose mind He dwells; the most excellent destiny is written on that forehead. ॥3॥
ਕਾਟਿ ਸਕਤਿ. ਸਿਵ ਸਹਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ; ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥
Shaking off the power of Maya, the light of God's poise has dawned; one has merged into the One.
340: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ; ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੭੪॥
Says Kabeer, meeting the Guru, I have found supreme peace; my mind has stopped wandering, and it is content. ॥4॥23॥74॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
Gauri Purbi · Bavan Akhri · Bhagat Kabir
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth, the Maker — realised by the Guru's grace
ਬਾਵਨ ਅਛਰ ਲੋਕ ਤ੍ਰੈ; ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Through these fifty-two letters, the three worlds and all things are described.
ਏ ਅਖਰ ਖਿਰਿ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ; ਓਇ ਅਖਰ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
These letters shall perish; they cannot describe the Imperishable Lord. ॥1॥
Wherever there is speech, there are letters.
ਜਹ ਅਬੋਲ; ਤਹ ਮਨੁ. ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
Where there is no speech, there the mind rests on nothing.
He is in both speech and silence.
ਜਸ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ; ਤਸ ਲਖੈ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
No one can know Him as He is. ॥2॥
ਅਲਹ ਲਹਉ. ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ; ਕਹਉ. ਤ ਕੋ ਉਪਕਾਰ ॥
If I come to know the Lord, what can I say? What good does it do to speak?
ਬਟਕ ਬੀਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ; ਜਾ ਕੋ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥੩॥
He is contained in the seed of the banyan tree, and yet His expanse spreads across the three worlds. ॥3॥
ਅਲਹ ਲਹੰਤਾ ਭੇਦ ਛੈ; ਕਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਭੇਦ ॥
Knowing the Lord, the mystery is dispelled, and I have come to understand a little of His mystery.
ਉਲਟਿ ਭੇਦ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ; ਪਾਇਓ ਅਭੰਗ ਅਛੇਦ ॥੪॥
Turning away from duality, my mind is pierced through, and I have obtained the indestructible, impenetrable Lord. ॥4॥
ਤੁਰਕ. ਤਰੀਕਤਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ; ਹਿੰਦੂ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
The Muslim is known by the Muslim way of life; the Hindu is known by the Vedas and Puranas.
ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਨ ਕਾਰਨੇ; ਕਛੂਅਕ ਪੜੀਐ ਗਿਆਨ ॥੫॥
To instruct the mind, one should study some spiritual wisdom. ॥5॥
I know only the One, the Universal Creator, the Primal Being.
ਲਿਖਿ ਅਰੁ ਮੇਟੈ; ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
I do not believe in anyone whom the Lord writes into existence and then erases.
If someone comes to know the One Universal Creator,
knowing Him, they are not destroyed. ॥6॥
Kakka: when the rays of divine light come into the heart-lotus,
the moonlight of Maya cannot enter the basket of the mind.
ਅਰੁ ਜੇ ਤਹਾ; ਕੁਸਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
And if one obtains the subtle fragrance of that spiritual flower,
one cannot describe the indescribable; one could speak, but who would understand? ॥7॥
Khakha: the mind has entered this cave.
ਖੋੜੇ ਛਾਡਿ; ਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
It does not leave this cave to wander in the ten directions.
Knowing its Lord and Master, people show compassion;
ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਖਿਅਉ; ਅਖੈ ਪਦੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੮॥
then they become immortal, and attain the state of everlasting dignity. ॥8॥
Gagga: one who understands the Guru's Word
does not listen to anything else.
He remains like a hermit and does not go anywhere,
when he grasps the Ungraspable Lord and dwells in the sky of the tenth gate. ॥9॥
Ghagha: He dwells in each and every heart.
ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ; ਘਟਿ. ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Even when the body-pitcher bursts, He does not decrease.
ਤਾ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ; ਘਾਟ ਜਉ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
When someone finds the Lord's crossing within his own heart,
ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਡਿ; ਅਵਘਟ ਕਤ ਧਾਵਾ ॥੧੦॥
why should he abandon that crossing to wander in treacherous places? ॥10॥
ਙੰਙਾ. ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ; ਨਿਰਵਾਰੋ ਸੰਦੇਹ ॥
Nganga: restrain yourself, love the Lord, and dismiss your doubts.
ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ. ਨ ਭਾਜੀਐ; ਪਰਮ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਏਹ ॥੧੧॥
Even if you do not see the way, do not run away; this is the highest wisdom. ॥11॥
Chachcha: He painted the great picture of the world.
Forget this picture, and remember the Painter.
This wondrous painting is now the problem.
Forget this picture and focus your consciousness on the Painter. ॥12॥
Chhachha: the Sovereign Lord of the universe is here with you.
ਛਕਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਰਹਹੁ; ਛਾਡਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
Why are you so unhappy? Why do you not abandon your desires?
ਰੇ ਮਨ. ਮੈ ਤਉ; ਛਿਨ ਛਿਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥
O my mind, each and every moment I try to instruct you,
but you forsake Him, and get yourself bound to others. ॥13॥
Jajja: if someone burns his body while still alive,
burning away the desires of his youth, he finds the right way.
ਅਸ ਜਰਿ ਪਰ ਜਰਿ; ਜਰਿ ਜਬ ਰਹੈ ॥
When he burns his desire for his own wealth, and for that of others,
then he goes and finds the radiant light of God. ॥14॥
